paper.title: HierGrid: A Reliability-First Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Physics-Verified Corrective Undervoltage

interpretation: The supplied manuscript already reports useful LLM-guided alternative trajectories retained by the hybrid safety envelope versus single DFF. Standalone HG-VF is not better in aggregateUV; selection non-regression is an architectural property; 18of20UVwins use moreQ. This is not superiority to equal-cost two-branch D-SE, external published systems, optimization, or unused confirmation.
cost_scope: Selected trajectoryQ/actions are not total two-branch computation. Both branches/model/training/preparation/failure costs must still be charged in new comparisons. Manuscript says wallclock sessions not uniform.
data_limit: Manuscript acknowledges proposer records and closed-loop evaluation originate from same physical replay population. Not unused confirmation.
explicit_correction: Earlier current-task notes describing227to3/22of25 as the supplied multi-agent paper primary result were incorrect for this PDF. Preserve those notes as history; this source-bound137-scenario correction supersedes them. Matching an aggregate227 alone cannot identify a cohort.
